Summary: James's hearing command: be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
Commandment: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
Application: The hearer-only is pictured as a man who looks in a mirror and forgets his face: hearing without doing is self-deception, not partial obedience.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: the hearer-only 'deceiveth his own self' (James 1:22), like one who forgets his face (James 1:24).
